question: Union Minister _________ announces India's first indigenously developed vaccine, "CERVAVAC" for the prevention of cervical cancer. (September 2022)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jitendra Singh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh announced India's first indigenously developed vaccine, "CERVAVAC**", for the prevention of cervical cancer in September 2022. 
 
• The **vaccine was developed by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT**) and **the Serum Institute of India (SII) in Pune,** in partnership with the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.
 
• The government plans to make Cervavac accessible to the population by incorporating it into the national immunization program.
 
• The **target age group for vaccination is girls between the ages of 9 and 14. **
 
• CERVAVAC is a vaccine aimed at preventing cervical cancer, which is primarily caused by persistent infection with high-risk types of human papillomavirus (HPV).
 
• **HPV types 16 and 18 are responsible for approximately 70% of cervical cancer cases worldwide.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shri Raj Nath Singh:**

 
 
• Rajnath Singh is the **Union Minister of Defence in India.**
 
• He has been involved in key initiatives related to India’s defence and security sectors, including modernization efforts for the Indian armed forces, indigenization of defence manufacturing, and various defence policy reforms. 
 
 
 
• **Dr. Bharati Pravin Pawar**:
 
 
• Dr. Bharati Pravin Pawar is the** Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare in India.**
 
 
 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh:**
 
 
• Dr. Jitendra Singh is the **Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology and Earth Sciences, as well as Minister of State for the Prime Minister's Office, Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions.**
 
• His portfolio includes overseeing scientific research and innovation in India.
